cards.lore: A fictional default built on somebody else's dystopia.
cards.power: Skip a turn while staring at the clouds; discard one resource to the Dystopia pile.

cards.lore: A cautionary tale that devolved into desperate escapism and a disaster capitalism product roadmap.
cards.power: Board freezes for one round. Player collects 3 profit tokens from the burning bank.

cards.lore: Takes and takes. Believes sustainability is just mitigating the damage we keep doing.
cards.power: Steal 1 resource from all other players to mitigate damage.

cards.lore: Proactive prototyping. A realistic vision of tackling inequities for a world built on reciprocity.
cards.power: Repair one broken board tile. Draw a card.

cards.lore: Evangelizing singular tech as a magic pill without a shred of critical inquiry.
cards.power: Instantly silence all critical inquiry cards in play.

cards.lore: Excludes the majority of the world. You aren't a real futurist unless you buy their models.
cards.power: Force an opponent from the Global South to pay 70k tokens just to play a card.

cards.lore: Profiteering from a tech-optimism that has brought us to the absolute brink.
cards.power: Destroy 3 worker-ants on your board for +1 Tech Ego point.

cards.lore: Sells a binary vision of civilizational collapse that paralyzes society into total inaction.
cards.power: Megaphone blast. All players lose their next action phase due to total paralysis.

cards.lore: Oh, the world is burning? I can make a lot of profit off harming people and the planet.
cards.power: Gain +5 Profit every time another player loses a resource to a fire or flood event.

cards.lore: Believes humans won't act without financial incentive. Distorts outcomes and harms processes.
cards.power: Convert an opponent's free action into a paid micro-transaction.

cards.lore: Make millions in fossil fuels, donate to effective charities, and call it corporate social responsibility.
cards.power: Generate 10 Toxic Waste tokens, then donate 1 token to charity to clear your reputation score.

cards.lore: The ultimate commoditization of the commons. Only the wealthy can afford to breathe.
cards.power: Privatize the commons. Players must pay you 1 token each turn just to draw a card.

cards.lore: Disregards present climate impacts for trillions of imaginary lives billions of years away.
cards.power: Ignore all present board damage. Claim victory points for imaginary games played a billion years from now.

cards.lore: Twisted logic arguing that AI armageddon research is a better charity than feeding a starving child.
cards.power: Sacrifice an opponent's low-tier card to Fund your high-tier AI Armageddon research.

cards.lore: Preaches "What Technology Wants" as inevitable, hiding the fact that specific humans designed it to abuse you.
cards.power: Deflect all blame. Immune to accountability cards because the technology wanted it.

cards.lore: Steals good words like "long-term" and strips them of meaning until nothing is real.
cards.power: Change the definition of any keyword on the board until it means nothing.

cards.lore: Consumes hundreds of times more than the poorest. A planetary model that requires ten Earths.
cards.power: Requires ten Earth board-spaces to play. Consumes 100x the resources of any other card.

cards.lore: Where the future actually happens. Contributed the least to climate impacts, set to suffer the worst.
cards.power: Take 3 damage for climate impacts you didn't cause, but gain the unblockable Pioneer Solution ability.

cards.lore: Hiring marginalized faces to sell exploitative crypto to vulnerable communities.
cards.power: Steal the aesthetic of a marginalized card to bypass corporate defense walls.

cards.lore: Dead people screwing up the future for the unborn by funding conservative agendas from the grave.
cards.power: Cast a vote from the discard pile that locks the current board state for the unborn.

cards.lore: Nothing is real, then everything is possible. Confuse the public to achieve geopolitical goals.
cards.power: Scramble the text of any rule card. Nothing is real, then everything is possible.

cards.lore: A brand new religion filling the narrative vacuum left by broken systems.
cards.power: Create a narrative vacuum. Gain +1 Follower for every broken system on the board.

cards.lore: Unconditioned for tech literacy, becoming the largest vector for the most outrageous conspiracies.
cards.power: Randomly distribute 3 Fake News damage tokens to younger player cards.

cards.lore: It's janky, it's cheap, but triggering the fear response makes the most money with the least imagination.
cards.power: Trigger fear response. Extract maximum profit tokens with zero imagination points spent.

cards.lore: Centering those at the absolute edge of technological and social harm prevents the greatest global impacts.
cards.power: Center the bleeding edge. Automatically prevents the next global harm event card from activating.

cards.lore: Plurality is survival. We need actual curiosity for divergent perspectives, not just tolerance.
cards.power: Plurality is survival. Convert an opponent's Either/Or attack into a Plurality resource.

cards.lore: Knew humans were a narrative species centuries before pop intellectuals sold millions of books saying it.
cards.power: Reveal the true history of a stolen board resource and reclaim it for the ecosystem.

cards.lore: Lived experience on the ground beats an Ivory Tower PhD when the water starts rising.
cards.power: Lived experience. Play 3 action cards simultaneously when the water starts rising.

cards.lore: Takes a highly privileged, Western, white, male perspective and pretends it is neutral.
cards.power: Stamp out diversity. Replace an opponent's unique card with a blank white square.

cards.lore: Invited to decolonize the project with unpaid labor, entirely uncredited in the final product.
cards.power: Decolonize a project for 0 tokens. The Corporate Expediter takes all the credit.

cards.lore: Predicted pandemics were a thing of the past right before COVID hit. Still refuses to answer for it.
cards.power: Ignore all pandemic damage but permanently lose all credibility points.

cards.lore: Consulting for industry just to help them sell more stuff with a thin veneer of sustainability.
cards.power: Apply a green veneer. Sell 3 toxic assets as sustainable for double profit.

cards.lore: A better future is in the making. The moment we repair something, there will be more to work on.
cards.power: A better future is in the making. The moment you repair a card, draw a new challenge card instantly.

cards.lore: The emergent political division: Extractive taking versus Regenerative repair.
cards.power: Turn toxic soil into flora. Convert 2 Extractive damage tokens into 1 Regenerative resource.

cards.lore: Must be integrated into primary schools AND elderly re-education to survive the conspiracy wave.
cards.power: Educate the board. Removes 1 Conspiracy token from all elderly cards in play.

cards.lore: A survival strategy. Not just tweaks to the status quo, but something fundamentally different from the root.
cards.power: Root change. Discard the status quo board and replace it with something fundamentally different.

cards.lore: The future is too complex for silos. We must cross-pollinate to survive.
cards.power: Cross-pollinate. Connect two entirely different scientific disciplines to bypass a silo block.

cards.lore: People are hungry for stories worth participating in. Awe is what people actually want to pay for.
cards.power: Light up the dark. Players voluntarily pay you tokens to participate in your story.

cards.lore: Make learning as addictive as a QAnon wormhole, but use it to tell stories that actually matter.
cards.power: Gamify survival. Make climate action as addictive as doomscrolling. Draw 2 cards.

cards.lore: Media must hold thought-leaders accountable when their heavily-funded futures fall or cause profound harm.
cards.power: Sniff out bad predictions. Force a Pop Futurist to discard their highest-funded failure.

cards.lore: When you just say "no no no" without a hopeful vision, nefarious actors fill the power vacuum.
cards.power: Say no no no. Nefarious actors immediately fill the empty spaces on your board.

cards.lore: The dominant narrative that one magical person will save the day—leading directly to populism.
cards.power: Wait to save everyone. Do nothing. Automatically triggers the Populism event card.

cards.lore: Look closely at the founders of elite futurism: full-on racist, ableist ideas disguised as math.
cards.power: Disguise racism as math. Burrow into an elite futurism deck and rot it from the inside.

cards.lore: Conspiracies aren't new. In the 19th century, they thought vaccines would turn you into a cow.
cards.power: Spread 19th-century paranoia. Convince opponents that health upgrades will turn them into livestock.

cards.lore: If you tell people what is coming, they change their behavior today. Futurists hold this exact same power.
cards.power: Adjust the dial. Change opponent behavior today by lying about what's coming tomorrow.

cards.lore: The huge responsibility of holding the Overton window open where hope actually lives.
cards.power: Hold the Overton open. Prevents the Hope card from being discarded this turn.

cards.lore: Erroneous language implying some nations are finished and dead, while others must copy their toxic growth.
cards.power: Deliver a colonial map. Force an opponent to copy your toxic growth model.

cards.lore: The dangerous lie that a single technology will solve deeply rooted sociological and anthropological crises.
cards.power: Swallow a microchip. Falsely claim a deep sociological crisis is solved. Lose 1 turn.

cards.lore: True optimism requires courage to act, and anger against apathy. Doomerism is cowardice.
cards.power: Courage to act. Defeat any Doomerism card instantly. You cannot skip your turn.

cards.lore: Top-up, not top-down. We find better solutions precisely because of our divergent cultural perspectives.
cards.power: Top-up architecture. Combine 3 divergent cultural cards to build an indestructible hive.

cards.lore: True equity means new grants to amplify Global South voices, not asking them to pay for their own flights.
cards.power: Regurgitate grants. Pay for a Global South player's flight instead of making them pay.

cards.lore: Moving past the corporate realm to engage citizens on a truly planetary scale. Is this the future we want?
cards.power: Planetary scale vision. Move past the corporate realm and engage all citizens. Win the board.

cards.lore: Pessimism paralyzes. Optimism must bom backed backed by action wins. You cannot skip your turn.
cards.power: Passive play is banned. Optimism must be backed by calloused hands.

cards.lore: No single player can win alone. You must trade cards with the margins.
cards.power: Trade cards with the margins. Winning alone is a Dystopian illusion.

cards.lore: Every time you draw, you must repair one piece of the board. The game is never finished.
cards.power: Weave shredded corporate docs into a nest.

cards.lore: If the rules favor the extractive player, flip the table and rewrite them. Stay fluffy!
cards.power: Flip the table. If the rules favor the extractive player, rewrite them.

title: Propositum 2040: Forget Utopia, Ignore Dystopia, Embrace Protopia
